svg.title: How watsonx Orchestrate works
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Find the agents you run. IBM says it scans supported third-party agent environments, Amazon Bedrock among them, and brings their agents into one control plane. Send work to the right agent. It coordinates native and external agents, tools and workflows, so the right agent or system acts at the right time. One set of rules. The same access, policy and guardrails across agents, tools and workflows, with activity traced and tool-call success tracked.
